title: Marketing va reklama tili
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ishontiruvchi shior yozasiz, maqsadli auditoriyani demografiya va qadriyatlar bilan tasvirlaysiz, brend ovozini izchil saqlaysiz va kampaniya natijasini raqamlar bilan baholaysiz.

scenes.title: Marketing va reklama tili
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda moliya va iqtisod tilini o‘rgandik. Bugun so‘zning o‘zi mahsulot bo‘ladigan sohaga — marketingga o‘tamiz. Dars oxirida siz ishontiruvchi til va shior tuzasiz, maqsadli auditoriyani aniq tasvirlaysiz, brend ovozini farqlaysiz va kampaniya natijasini raqamlar bilan baholaysiz. Marketing ingliz tilida juda ko‘p qisqartma va jargon ishlatadi, lekin yaxshi marketolog murakkab so‘zni emas, aniq fikrni afzal ko‘radi. Bugun ikkalasini ham o‘rganamiz: kasbiy lug‘atni va uni sodda, ta’sirli gapga aylantirishni.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we dealt with finance and economics. Today we move to a field where words are the product: marketing. You will learn to persuade, to describe the customer, to keep a consistent brand voice and to judge whether a campaign worked.
scenes.say_uz: Qaytganingizdan xursandman. O‘tgan safar moliya va iqtisodni ko‘rdik. Bugun so‘zlar mahsulotning o‘zi bo‘ladigan sohaga o‘tamiz: marketingga. Ishontirishni, mijozni tasvirlashni, brend ovozini bir xil saqlashni va kampaniya ishlaganini baholashni o‘rganasiz.

scenes.title: Ishontiruvchi til va shiorlar

examples.t: Built to last. Designed to be loved.
examples.uz: Uzoq xizmat qilish uchun qurilgan. Sevilish uchun yaratilgan.

examples.t: Why settle for ordinary when you can have extraordinary?
examples.uz: Oddiyga nega rozi bo‘lasiz, g‘ayrioddiyga ega bo‘lish mumkin bo‘lsa?

examples.t: Fast, fair and friendly.
examples.uz: Tez, adolatli va samimiy.

scenes.say_native: Yaxshi shior qisqa, ritmik va foyda va’da qiladi. Uning ortida bir nechta ishonchli usul bor. „Uchlik qoidasi“ — „rule of three“ — ritm beradi: „fast, fair and friendly“. Buyruq shakli — „imperative“ — to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri murojaat qiladi: „try it today“. Ritorik savol o‘quvchini rozilikka undaydi. „Alliteration“ — bir xil tovushni takrorlash — satrni esda qoldiradi. Eng ishontiruvchi so‘z esa „you“, chunki gap o‘quvchi haqida. Muhim qoida: xususiyat emas, foyda sotiladi. „Battery lasts 20 hours“ — xususiyat; „a full week without a charger“ — foyda, ya’ni mijozga nima beradi.
scenes.say: A good slogan is short, rhythmic and promises a benefit. Writers rely on a few reliable devices. The rule of three gives rhythm: fast, fair and friendly. An imperative speaks directly: try it today. A rhetorical question invites agreement. Alliteration, repeating a sound, makes a line memorable. And you is the most persuasive word, because it is about the reader.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi shior qisqa, ritmik va foyda va’da qiladi. Mualliflar bir necha usuldan foydalanadi. Uchlik qoidasi ritm beradi: tez, adolatli, samimiy. Buyruq shakli to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri gapiradi. Ritorik savol rozilikka undaydi. Alliteratsiya satrni esda qoldiradi. Eng ishontiruvchi so‘z — you, chunki u o‘quvchi haqida.

scenes.title: Xato: shior xususiyat sanaydi
board: ✗ Our product has advanced ergonomic technology
✓ Sit comfortably for hours, not minutes

examples.t: Features tell; benefits sell.
examples.uz: Xususiyatlar tushuntiradi; foydalar sotadi.

examples.t: Wake up to a quieter city.
examples.uz: Tinchroq shaharga uyg‘oning.

scenes.say_native: Reklama matnidagi eng keng tarqalgan zaiflik — foyda o‘rniga xususiyatni sanash. „Our mattress contains three layers of memory foam“ — xususiyat. „Wake up without a sore back“ — foyda: mijoz buni his qiladi. O‘zbek tilida ham „sifatli, zamonaviy, qulay“ kabi bo‘sh so‘zlar ko‘p, inglizchada „the best ever“ ham shunday. Ular hamma brendda bir xil eshitiladi. Bundan tashqari, isbotlanmagan „eng yaxshi“ da’volar ko‘p mamlakatlarda reklama qoidalariga zid bo‘lishi mumkin. Shuning uchun aniq va’da yozing: nima o‘zgaradi, qancha vaqtda, kim uchun.
scenes.say: The most common weakness in advertising copy is listing features instead of benefits. Our mattress contains three layers of memory foam is a feature. Wake up without a sore back is a benefit. Also avoid empty superlatives such as the best ever. They sound like every other brand, and in many countries unproven claims like these can break advertising rules.
scenes.say_uz: Reklama matnida eng keng tarqalgan zaiflik — foyda o‘rniga xususiyatlarni sanash. Matrasda uch qatlam bor — xususiyat. Orqangiz og‘rimasdan uyg‘oning — foyda. Eng yaxshi kabi bo‘sh sifatlardan ham qoching: ular hamma brendda bir xil eshitiladi va isbotlanmasa, qoidalarga zid bo‘lishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Mashq: foydani toping
board: 1) A backpack with a padded laptop sleeve
2) An app that tracks monthly spending
3) Write one slogan using the rule of three
scenes.say_native: Xususiyatlarni foydaga aylantiring. Birinchisi: noutbuk uchun yumshoq cho‘ntagi bor ryukzak. Ikkinchisi: oylik xarajatlarni kuzatadigan ilova. Keyin qahvaxona uchun uchlik qoidasi asosida bitta qisqa shior yozing. Har bir foydada „you“ ni ishlatib ko‘ring: mijoz nima qiladi, nimani his qiladi? Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: Turn features into benefits. One: a backpack with a padded laptop sleeve. Two: an app that tracks your monthly spending. Then write one short slogan for a coffee shop using the rule of three.
scenes.say_uz: Xususiyatlarni foydaga aylantiring. Noutbuk uchun yumshoq cho‘ntagi bor ryukzak. Oylik xarajatlarni kuzatadigan ilova. Keyin qahvaxona uchun uchlik qoidasi asosida bitta qisqa shior yozing.

scenes.title: Javoblar: foyda va shior
board: Fresh beans. Fair prices. Friendly faces.

examples.t: Fresh beans, fair prices, friendly faces.
examples.uz: Yangi donlar, adolatli narxlar, samimiy yuzlar.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Ryukzak uchun: noutbukingizni zarbalardan qo‘rqmasdan olib yuring. Ilova uchun: har oy pulingiz qayerga ketayotganini aniq ko‘ring. Qahvaxona uchun: „Fresh beans, fair prices, friendly faces“. Bu satrda ham uchlik qoidasi, ham alliteratsiya bor, chunki „fresh“, „fair“, „friendly“ bir xil tovushdan boshlanadi. Sizning variantingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi tabiiy. Muhimi, har bir javob mijozga nima berishini aytsin va ritmi qulay bo‘lsin. Shiorni baland ovozda o‘qib ko‘ring: ritm quloqqa yoqmasa, o‘zgartiring.
scenes.say: Sample answers. For the backpack: carry your laptop without worrying about bumps. For the app: see exactly where your money goes each month. And for the coffee shop: fresh beans, fair prices, friendly faces. That last line uses both the rule of three and alliteration, since fresh, fair and friendly share a sound.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javoblar. Ryukzak: noutbukingizni zarbalardan qo‘rqmasdan olib yuring. Ilova: har oy pulingiz qayerga ketayotganini aniq ko‘ring. Qahvaxona: yangi donlar, adolatli narxlar, samimiy yuzlar. Oxirgi satrda uchlik qoidasi ham, alliteratsiya ham bor.

scenes.title: Maqsadli auditoriyani tasvirlash
board: aimed at · targets · appeals to · is geared towards

examples.t: The campaign is aimed at first-time buyers in their late twenties.
examples.uz: Kampaniya yigirma yoshlarning oxiridagi birinchi marta xarid qiluvchilarga qaratilgan.

examples.t: Our core audience is urban professionals who value convenience over price.
examples.uz: Asosiy auditoriyamiz narxdan ko‘ra qulaylikni qadrlaydigan shahar mutaxassislaridir.

examples.t: The brand appeals to people who care about sustainability.
examples.uz: Brend barqarorlikka e’tibor beradigan odamlarga murojaat qiladi.

scenes.say_native: Maqsadli auditoriyani ikki qatlamda tasvirlang. „Demographics“ — o‘lchanadigan faktlar: yosh, daromad, joylashuv, kasb. „Psychographics“ — qadriyatlar, odatlar, motivlar. Foydali fe’llar: „be aimed at“ — qaratilgan, „target“ — mo‘ljallamoq, „appeal to“ — yoqmoq, murojaat qilmoq, „be geared towards“ — moslashtirilgan. „Persona“ — segmentni ifodalovchi xayoliy, lekin real odam: ismi, kundalik tartibi, muammolari bor. Demografiya „kim“ ekanini aytadi, psixografiya esa „nima uchun sotib oladi“ ni. Faqat yosh va jins bilan tasvirlash yetarli emas: bir xil yoshdagi ikki odam butunlay boshqacha xarid qilishi mumkin.
scenes.say: To describe a target audience, use two layers. Demographics are measurable facts: age, income, location, job. Psychographics describe values, habits and motivations. Useful verbs are aimed at, targets, appeals to and is geared towards. A persona is a fictional but realistic person who stands for a segment, with a name, daily routine and frustrations.
scenes.say_uz: Auditoriyani ikki qatlamda tasvirlang. Demografiya o‘lchanadigan faktlar: yosh, daromad, joylashuv, kasb. Psixografiya qadriyatlar, odatlar va motivlarni tasvirlaydi. Foydali fe’llar: aimed at, targets, appeals to, is geared towards. Persona — segmentni ifodalovchi xayoliy, lekin real odam.

scenes.title: Xato: juda keng auditoriya
board: ✓ It is aimed at remote workers aged 25–40

examples.t: The product is designed for busy parents, not for students.
examples.uz: Mahsulot band ota-onalar uchun mo‘ljallangan, talabalar uchun emas.

examples.t: Customers who value quality tend to stay loyal.
examples.uz: Sifatni qadrlaydigan mijozlar sodiq qolishga moyil.

scenes.say_native: Mijoz „mahsulot hamma uchun“ desa, marketolog buni strategiya yo‘q deb eshitadi. Aniq bo‘ling: „aimed at remote workers aged 25 to 40“. Bitta grammatik nuqta ham bor. „People“ ko‘plik, shuning uchun „people who are interested“ deymiz, „people who is“ emas. O‘zbek tilida „odamlar“ ko‘plik qo‘shimchasi bilan keladi, inglizcha „people“ esa o‘zi ko‘plik, shuning uchun „peoples“ yoki „a people“ deb yozmang, bu ma’noda.
scenes.say: When a client says our product is for everyone, a marketer hears no strategy. Be specific. One grammar point also matters. The word people is plural, so say people who are interested, not people who is interested.
scenes.say_uz: Mijoz mahsulot hamma uchun desa, marketolog strategiya yo‘q deb eshitadi. Aniq bo‘ling. Bitta grammatik nuqta ham muhim: people ko‘plik, shuning uchun people who are interested deymiz.

scenes.title: Mashq: auditoriya tavsifi
board: 2) Give age, location and one value
scenes.say_native: Byudjetga mos fitnes ilova uchun maqsadli auditoriyani ikki gapda tasvirlang. Yosh oralig‘ini, joylashuv turini va bitta motivni ayting. Birinchi gapda „is aimed at“, ikkinchi gapda „who value“ ishlating. Masalan, kimlar uchun: talabalar, yosh mutaxassislar yoki ota-onalar. Nima uchun ular qimmat zaldan ko‘ra ilovani tanlaydi? Javobingiz keyingi sahnada tekshiriladi.
scenes.say: Describe the target audience for a budget fitness app in two sentences. Give an age range, a location type and one motivation. Use is aimed at in the first sentence and who value in the second.
scenes.say_uz: Byudjetga mos fitnes ilova uchun maqsadli auditoriyani ikki gapda tasvirlang. Yosh oralig‘ini, joylashuv turini va bitta motivni ayting. Birinchi gapda is aimed at, ikkinchisida who value ishlating.

scenes.title: Javoblar: auditoriya
board: who value flexibility and low cost

examples.t: The app is aimed at city-dwellers aged twenty-two to thirty-five.
examples.uz: Ilova yigirma ikkidan o‘ttiz besh yoshgacha shahar aholisiga qaratilgan.

scenes.say_native: Namuna: „The app is aimed at city-dwellers aged twenty-two to thirty-five. They are people who value flexibility and low cost over a gym contract.“ Birinchi gap demografiyani beradi: yosh va joylashuv. Ikkinchi gap psixografiyani: qadriyat, ya’ni moslashuvchanlik va arzonlik. Ikkalasi birga aniq tasvir hosil qiladi. Diqqat: „people who value“ da fe’l „value“ ko‘plikda, „-s“ yo‘q. Agar sizda boshqa yosh yoki shahar bo‘lsa ham, tuzilma shu bo‘lsa, javob to‘g‘ri. Reklama agentligida bu ikki gap ko‘pincha brifning birinchi satri bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: A model answer: The app is aimed at city-dwellers aged twenty-two to thirty-five. They are people who value flexibility and low cost over a gym contract. Notice that the first sentence gives demographics, while the second gives a value, which is psychographics. Together they form a clear picture.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javob. Ilova yigirma ikkidan o‘ttiz besh yoshgacha shahar aholisiga qaratilgan. Ular zal shartnomasidan ko‘ra moslashuvchanlik va arzonlikni qadrlaydigan odamlar. Birinchi gap demografiyani, ikkinchisi psixografiyani beradi.

scenes.title: Brend ovozi
board: style guide: words we use / words we avoid

examples.t: Our voice is warm and plain-spoken, never pushy.
examples.uz: Bizning ovozimiz iliq va sodda, hech qachon bosim o‘tkazmaydi.

examples.t: We say "you" and "we", and we use contractions.
examples.uz: Biz "you" va "we" deymiz va qisqartmalardan foydalanamiz.

examples.t: In an apology, our tone is calm and direct, but the voice stays the same.
examples.uz: Uzr so‘rashda ohangimiz xotirjam va to‘g‘ri, lekin ovoz o‘sha-o‘sha.

scenes.say_native: „Brand voice“ — brendning so‘zdagi shaxsiyati, u doim bir xil qoladi. „Tone“ — muayyan vaziyatdagi kayfiyat, u o‘zgaradi. Masalan, bank doim xotirjam va aniq gapiradi, bu uning ovozi. Firibgarlik haqida ogohlantirishda ohang jiddiyroq, tug‘ilgan kun xatida esa iliqroq bo‘ladi, ammo ovoz o‘zgarmaydi. Ovozni tavsiflash uchun sifatlar ishlatiladi: „friendly“, „authoritative“, „playful“, „formal“. „Style guide“ esa qo‘llanma: qaysi so‘zlarni ishlatamiz, qaysilarini yo‘q, „we“ yoki „the company“ deymizmi, qisqartmalar mumkinmi. Bu o‘zbek tilidagi „siz“ va „sen“ tanlovi bilan o‘xshash: tanlov brend uchun bir marta qilinadi.
scenes.say: Brand voice is the personality of a brand in words, and it stays constant. Tone is the mood in a particular moment, and it changes. A bank might always sound calm and clear, yet its tone in a fraud alert is more serious than in a birthday email. A style guide records the words we use, the words we avoid and how formal we are.
scenes.say_uz: Brend ovozi — brendning so‘zdagi shaxsiyati, u doimiy. Ohang esa muayyan lahzadagi kayfiyat, u o‘zgaradi. Bank doim xotirjam va aniq gapirishi mumkin, lekin firibgarlik haqidagi ogohlantirishda ohangi jiddiyroq. Uslub qo‘llanmasi qaysi so‘zlarni ishlatish va qaysilaridan qochishni belgilaydi.

scenes.title: Xato: ovoz va ohangni aralashtirish

examples.t: Consistency builds trust: customers should recognise us in any channel.
examples.uz: Izchillik ishonch yaratadi: mijozlar bizni har qanday kanalda taniydi.

examples.t: A joke in a complaint reply can sound careless.
examples.uz: Shikoyatga javobdagi hazil beparvolikdek eshitilishi mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Ko‘pchilik ovoz va ohangni aralashtiradi. Ba’zi brendlar esa kanaldan kanalga ovozini o‘zgartiradi, bu ishonchni buzadi. Agar brend saytida iliq va sodda gapirsa, SMS da birdan quruq va qonuniy tilga o‘tmasligi kerak. Ohangni vaziyatga moslang, shaxsiyatni saqlang. „Voice“ — nima uchun bizni tanishadi, „tone“ — hozir qanday gapiryapmiz. Yana bir qoida: mijoz xafa bo‘lganda hazil qilmang. Shikoyatga javobdagi hazil beparvolik kabi eshitiladi, hatto ko‘ngilli maqsadda yozilgan bo‘lsa ham. Izchillik ishonch beradi, bu marketingning asosiy tushunchalaridan biri.
scenes.say: Learners often confuse voice and tone, and some brands change their voice from channel to channel. That breaks trust. If your brand is warm and plain-spoken on its website, it should not become stiff and legalistic in a text message. Adapt the tone to the situation, but keep the same personality. And never joke when a customer is upset.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘pchilik ovoz va ohangni aralashtiradi, ba’zi brendlar esa kanaldan kanalga ovozini o‘zgartiradi. Bu ishonchni buzadi. Ohangni vaziyatga moslang, lekin shaxsiyatni saqlang. Mijoz xafa bo‘lganda hech qachon hazil qilmang.

scenes.title: Mashq: ovozni moslashtiring
board: 1) Rewrite: "We regret to inform you of a delay."
2) Write a cheerful opening line for a newsletter
scenes.say_native: Iliq va sodda gapiradigan novvoyxona uchun ikkita satr yozing. Birinchisi: „We regret to inform you of a delay“ ni iliqroq va soddaroq ovozda qayta yozing. Ikkinchisi: haftalik xabarnoma uchun quvnoq birinchi satr. Shaxsiyat bir xil qolsin, ohang esa vaziyatga mos bo‘lsin: birinchi satr kechikish haqida, shuning uchun jiddiyroq, ikkinchisi esa quvnoqroq. Javobingizni ayting, keyingi sahnada namunani eshitasiz.
scenes.say: A friendly, plain-spoken bakery needs two lines. First, rewrite We regret to inform you of a delay in a warmer, simpler voice. Second, write a cheerful opening line for its weekly newsletter. Keep the personality the same, but adapt the tone.
scenes.say_uz: Iliq va sodda gapiradigan novvoyxona uchun ikkita satr yozing. We regret to inform you of a delay jumlasini iliqroq va soddaroq ovozda qayta yozing. Keyin haftalik xabarnoma uchun quvnoq birinchi satr yozing. Shaxsiyat bir xil, ohang esa moslashsin.

scenes.title: Javoblar: brend ovozi
board: Sorry, your order is running late.
Fresh from the oven this week: warm cinnamon buns!

examples.t: Sorry, your order is running a little late, and we are on it.
examples.uz: Uzr, buyurtmangiz biroz kechikmoqda, biz ustida ishlayapmiz.

scenes.say_native: Mumkin variant: „Sorry, your order is running a little late, and we are on it.“ Ohang — uzr so‘rovchi va xotirjam, so‘zlar esa sodda: „regret to inform“ o‘rniga „sorry“. Xabarnoma uchun: „Fresh from the oven this week, warm cinnamon buns and a few surprises.“ Ohang quvnoq. Ikkala matnda ham ovoz o‘sha: iliq va sodda. Faqat kayfiyat vaziyatga qarab o‘zgardi. Eslab qoling: „we regret to inform you“ rasmiy kompaniya tili, u iliq brendga yarashmaydi. Uslub qo‘llanmasida bunday iboralarni „avoid“ ro‘yxatiga qo‘shish mumkin.
scenes.say: A possible rewrite: Sorry, your order is running a little late, and we are on it. The tone is apologetic and calm. For the newsletter: Fresh from the oven this week, warm cinnamon buns and a few surprises. The tone is cheerful. The voice, friendly and plain, did not change, while the tone moved with the situation.
scenes.say_uz: Mumkin variant: kechirasiz, buyurtmangiz biroz kechikmoqda va biz ustida ishlayapmiz. Ohang uzr so‘rovchi va xotirjam. Xabarnoma uchun: bu hafta pechdan yangi, issiq darchinli bulochkalar va bir nechta kutilmagan narsa. Ohang quvnoq. Ovoz o‘zgarmadi, ohang esa vaziyatga qarab o‘zgardi.

scenes.title: Kampaniyani baholash
board: conversion rate · cost per acquisition · ROI
exceeded the target · fell short of · A/B test

examples.t: The campaign reached two million people, and the click-through rate was three per cent.
examples.uz: Kampaniya ikki million odamga yetib bordi, bosish ko‘rsatkichi uch foiz bo‘ldi.

examples.t: Conversion rate exceeded the target by half a point.
examples.uz: Konversiya ko‘rsatkichi maqsaddan yarim punktga oshdi.

examples.t: The second version outperformed the first in an A/B test.
examples.uz: Ikkinchi variant A/B testda birinchisidan yaxshi natija ko‘rsatdi.

scenes.say_native: Kampaniyani baholashda maqsaddan boshlang, keyin raqamlarni o‘qing. „Reach“ — nechta turli odam ko‘rdi. „Impressions“ — barcha ko‘rishlar soni, bir odam bir necha marta ko‘rsa ham. „Click-through rate“, qisqacha CTR — bosishlar sonining ko‘rishlarga nisbati. „Conversion rate“ — kerakli amalni, masalan xaridni bajarganlar ulushi. „ROI“ — „return on investment“ — foyda va xarajat nisbati. „Cost per acquisition“ — bitta yangi mijozni jalb qilish narxi. Natijani maqsad bilan solishtirib: „exceeded the target“ — oshdi, „fell short of“ — yetmadi, „met the target“ — erishildi. „A/B test“ — ikki variantni solishtirish.
scenes.say: To evaluate a campaign, start from the goal and then read the numbers. Reach is how many different people saw it. Impressions count every view. Click-through rate is clicks divided by impressions. Conversion rate is the share of people who took the desired action, such as buying. ROI, return on investment, compares gain with cost. Say exceeded the target or fell short of it.
scenes.say_uz: Kampaniyani maqsaddan boshlab baholang. Reach — nechta turli odam ko‘rdi. Impressions — barcha ko‘rishlar. CTR — bosishlar ko‘rishlarga bo‘linadi. Konversiya — kerakli amalni bajarganlar ulushi. ROI foyda va xarajatni solishtiradi. Natijani maqsad bilan solishtirib, oshdi yoki yetmadi deb ayting.

scenes.title: Xato: raqamni sharhsiz berish
board: ✓ CTR was 3%, above our 2% target, which suggests the message resonated

examples.t: Impressions rose, but conversions stayed flat, so the traffic was not qualified.
examples.uz: Ko‘rishlar ko‘paydi, lekin konversiyalar o‘zgarmadi, ya’ni trafik mos emas edi.

examples.t: A vanity metric looks good but does not drive decisions.
examples.uz: Ko‘rinish uchun metrika chiroyli ko‘rinadi, lekin qarorga yordam bermaydi.

scenes.say_native: Yalang‘och raqam kam narsa aytadi. Maqsadni, solishtirishni va xulosani qo‘shing: „CTR was three per cent, above our two per cent target, which suggests the message resonated“. „Vanity metric“ — ko‘rinish uchun metrika — dan ehtiyot bo‘ling: ko‘rishlar yoki obunachilar o‘sishi mumkin, sotuv esa yo‘q. Maqsadga bog‘liq ko‘rsatkichni afzal ko‘ring. Yana: bog‘liqlik isbot emas, shuning uchun „proves“ emas, „suggests“ yoki „is consistent with“ deng. Imloga ham e’tibor bering: „successful“ so‘zida ikkita „c“ va ikkita „s“ bor. Bu so‘zni imtihonlarda ko‘p noto‘g‘ri yozishadi.
scenes.say: A bare number says little. Give the target, the comparison and what you conclude. Be careful with vanity metrics: impressions or followers can grow while sales do not. Prefer metrics tied to the goal. Also note that correlation is not proof, so say suggests or is consistent with rather than proves. And check spelling: successful has two c's and two s's.
scenes.say_uz: Yalang‘och raqam kam narsa aytadi. Maqsadni, solishtirishni va xulosani qo‘shing. Ko‘rinish uchun metrikalardan ehtiyot bo‘ling: ko‘rishlar o‘sib, sotuv o‘smasligi mumkin. Bog‘liqlik isbot emas, shuning uchun proves emas, suggests deng. Successful so‘zida ikkita c va ikkita s bor.

scenes.title: Mashq: natijani sharhlang
scenes.say_native: Natijalarni bittadan gap bilan sharhlang. Birinchisi: CTR maqsadi ikki foiz edi, haqiqiy natija uch butun ikki o‘ndan foiz. Ikkinchisi: konversiya maqsadi besh foiz, natija uch butun sakkiz o‘ndan foiz. Uchinchisi: ko‘rishlar qirq foizga oshdi, sotuv esa o‘zgarmadi. „Exceeded“, „fell short of“ va „suggests“ so‘zlarini ishlating. Javoblaringiz keyingi sahnada.
scenes.say: Comment on these results in one sentence each. The click-through target was two per cent and the actual was three point two. The conversion target was five per cent and the actual was three point eight. And impressions rose by forty per cent while sales stayed flat.
scenes.say_uz: Natijalarni bittadan gap bilan sharhlang. CTR maqsadi ikki foiz, natija uch butun ikki o‘ndan foiz. Konversiya maqsadi besh foiz, natija uch butun sakkiz o‘ndan foiz. Ko‘rishlar qirq foizga oshdi, sotuv o‘zgarmadi.

scenes.title: Javoblar: baholash
board: CTR exceeded the target by 1.2 points.
Conversion fell short of the target.
Visibility up, sales flat: wrong audience?

examples.t: Conversion fell short of the five per cent target.
examples.uz: Konversiya besh foizlik maqsaddan past qoldi.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy sharhlar. CTR maqsaddan bir butun ikki o‘ndan foiz bandga oshdi: „exceeded the target by 1.2 percentage points“. Konversiya besh foizlik maqsaddan past qoldi: „fell short of“. Ko‘rishlar qirq foizga oshdi, sotuv o‘zgarmadi — bu „suggests“, ya’ni kampaniya noto‘g‘ri auditoriyaga yetgan yoki taklif kuchsiz bo‘lgan bo‘lishi mumkin. E’tibor bering: biz sababni qat’iy aytmadik, ikkita ehtimolni keltirdik. Bu professional ehtiyotkorlik. Keyingi qadam: A/B test o‘tkazib, taklif va auditoriyani alohida sinash.
scenes.say: Model comments. Click-through rate exceeded the target by one point two percentage points. Conversion fell short of the five per cent target, at three point eight. Impressions rose by forty per cent while sales stayed flat, which suggests that the campaign reached the wrong audience or that the offer was weak.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy sharhlar. CTR maqsaddan bir butun ikki o‘ndan foiz bandga oshdi. Konversiya besh foizlik maqsaddan past qoldi. Ko‘rishlar qirq foizga oshdi, sotuv o‘zgarmadi, bu kampaniya noto‘g‘ri auditoriyaga yetganini yoki taklif kuchsizligini ko‘rsatishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: kreativ brif
board: A: Who are we talking to?
B: Young families, outside the city centre.
A: And what should they feel?
B: That we make busy mornings easier.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi suhbat — kreativ brif muhokamasi. Menejer so‘raydi: biz kim bilan gaplashyapmiz? Javob: shahar markazidan tashqarida yashaydigan, vaqti kam yosh oilalar. Ular nimani his qilishi kerak? Band ertalablar osonlashganini. Shunda uzun texnik da’volardan qochamiz: bitta aniq va’da, iliq ovoz va bitta chaqiriq. Eshiting: „who are we talking to“ — auditoriya, „short of time“ — vaqti kam, „call to action“ — harakatga chaqiriq, masalan „Order today“.
scenes.say: Before we draft anything, who are we talking to? Young families, mostly living outside the city centre, who are short of time. And what should they feel? That we make busy mornings easier. Then let us avoid long technical claims. One clear promise, a warm voice and a single call to action.
scenes.say_uz: Biror narsa yozishdan oldin, biz kim bilan gaplashyapmiz? Asosan shahar markazidan tashqarida yashaydigan, vaqti kam yosh oilalar bilan. Ular nimani his qilishi kerak? Biz band ertalablarni osonlashtirishimizni. Unda uzun texnik da’volardan qochamiz. Bitta aniq va’da, iliq ovoz va bitta chaqiriq.

scenes.title: Suhbat 1 bo‘yicha savollar
board: 3) What three things does the speaker recommend?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchisi: auditoriya kim? Ikkinchisi: ular brend haqida nimani his qilishi kerak? Uchinchisi: so‘zlovchi xabar uchun qaysi uchta narsani tavsiya qiladi? Javobni to‘liq gapda, auditoriyani tasvirlashdagi fe’llar bilan ayting.
scenes.say: Three questions. Who is the audience? What should they feel about the brand? And what three things does the speaker recommend for the message?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savol. Auditoriya kim? Ular brend haqida nimani his qilishi kerak? So‘zlovchi xabar uchun qaysi uchta narsani tavsiya qiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 1
board: one promise · warm voice · one call to action
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Auditoriya — shahar markazidan tashqarida yashaydigan, vaqti kam yosh oilalar. Ular brend band ertalablarni osonlashtirishini his qilishi kerak. So‘zlovchi uchta narsani tavsiya qiladi: bitta aniq va’da, iliq ovoz va bitta harakatga chaqiriq, uzun texnik da’volarsiz. Bu bugungi darsning deyarli hammasi: auditoriya, foyda, ovoz. Eslab qoling, „single call to action“ — bitta chaqiriq: bir nechta tugma o‘quvchini chalg‘itadi, shuning uchun reklamada „Order today“ kabi faqat bittasi bo‘lgani yaxshi.
scenes.say: The audience is young families living outside the city centre who are short of time. They should feel that the brand makes busy mornings easier. The speaker recommends one clear promise, a warm voice and a single call to action, and no long technical claims.
scenes.say_uz: Auditoriya — shahar markazidan tashqarida yashaydigan, vaqti kam yosh oilalar. Ular brend band ertalablarni osonlashtirishini his qilishi kerak. So‘zlovchi bitta aniq va’da, iliq ovoz va bitta harakatga chaqiriqni tavsiya qiladi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: kampaniya sharhi
board: A: Reach was strong, but conversions lagged.
B: Did we test the headline?
A: Yes. Version B won by a clear margin.
B: Then let us roll it out.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbat — o‘tgan oy kampaniyasi sharhi. Birinchi hamkasb: qamrov kuchli bo‘ldi, lekin konversiya maqsaddan orqada qoldi. Ikkinchisi: sarlavhani sinadikmi? Ha, B variant A dan aniq farq bilan yaxshi chiqdi, shuning uchun uni barcha kanallarda ishga tushirish kerak. Rozi. Eng zaif reklama guruhini olib tashlab, byudjetini boshqasiga o‘tkazamiz. Eshiting: „lagged behind“ — orqada qoldi, „by a clear margin“ — aniq ustunlik bilan, „roll out“ — ishga tushirmoq, „shift the budget“ — byudjetni ko‘chirmoq.
scenes.say: Let us review last month. Reach was strong, but conversions lagged behind the target. Did we test the headline? Yes, version B outperformed version A by a clear margin, so we should roll it out across all channels. Agreed. Let us also drop the weakest ad set and shift its budget.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan oyni ko‘rib chiqaylik. Qamrov kuchli bo‘ldi, lekin konversiya maqsaddan orqada qoldi. Sarlavhani sinadikmi? Ha, B variant A dan aniq farq bilan yaxshi chiqdi, shuning uchun uni barcha kanallarda ishga tushirishimiz kerak. Rozi. Eng zaif reklama guruhini olib tashlab, byudjetni ko‘chiramiz.

scenes.title: Suhbat 2 bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) What was strong, and what lagged?
3) What will they do with the weakest ad set?
scenes.say_native: Sharh bo‘yicha savollarga javob bering. Nima kuchli bo‘ldi va nima orqada qoldi? Sarlavhaning qaysi varianti g‘alaba qozondi? Jamoa eng zaif reklama guruhi bilan nima qiladi? Fe’llarni to‘g‘ri zamonda ayting.
scenes.say: Questions about the review. What was strong and what lagged behind? Which version of the headline won? And what will the team do with the weakest ad set?
scenes.say_uz: Sharh bo‘yicha savollar. Nima kuchli bo‘ldi va nima orqada qoldi? Sarlavhaning qaysi varianti yutdi? Jamoa eng zaif reklama guruhi bilan nima qiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 2
board: drop it and shift the budget
scenes.say_native: Qamrov kuchli bo‘ldi, konversiya esa maqsaddan orqada qoldi. Sarlavhaning B varianti aniq ustunlik bilan yutdi. Jamoa eng zaif reklama guruhini olib tashlaydi va uning byudjetini boshqa joyga ko‘chiradi. Ko‘ryapsizmi, qaror ma’lumotdan kelib chiqadi, bu A/B testning maqsadi. Gapni quring: avval natija, keyin sabab yoki taxmin, keyin qaror. Shu tartib kampaniya sharhida ham, yozma hisobotda ham ishlaydi. Endi hamma narsani birlashtiradigan yakuniy topshiriqqa o‘tamiz.
scenes.say: Reach was strong, while conversions lagged behind the target. Version B of the headline won by a clear margin. The team will drop the weakest ad set and shift its budget elsewhere. So the decision follows from the data, which is the point of an A/B test.
scenes.say_uz: Qamrov kuchli, konversiya esa maqsaddan orqada edi. Sarlavhaning B varianti aniq ustunlik bilan yutdi. Jamoa eng zaif reklama guruhini olib tashlaydi va byudjetini ko‘chiradi. Qaror ma’lumotdan kelib chiqadi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: reklama va reja
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Mahsulot — qayta ishlatiladigan suv shishasi. Ovoz chiqarib ayting: ishontiruvchi usul ishlatilgan bitta shior, maqsadli auditoriyaning bir gapdagi tavsifi va kampaniya uchun maqsad raqami bilan bitta o‘lchanadigan ko‘rsatkich. Masalan, CTR, konversiya yoki yangi mijoz narxi. Foyda haqida o‘ylang: shisha mijozga nima beradi? Tayyor bo‘lgach, namunani eshiting.
scenes.say: Final task. Your product is a reusable water bottle. Say a slogan using a persuasive device, describe the target audience in one sentence, and name one measurable goal for the campaign with a target number.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy topshiriq. Mahsulot — qayta ishlatiladigan suv shishasi. Ishontiruvchi usul bilan shior ayting, auditoriyani bir gapda tasvirlang va maqsad raqami bilan bitta o‘lchanadigan ko‘rsatkichni ayting.

scenes.title: Namuna: reklama va reja

examples.t: Refill, reuse, repeat.
examples.uz: To‘ldiring, qayta ishlating, takrorlang.

scenes.say_native: Namuna: „Refill, reuse, repeat“ — uchlik qoidasi va takrorlanuvchi tovush, shior qisqa va ritmik. Auditoriya: yigirmadan o‘ttiz besh yoshgacha, chiqindi haqida qayg‘uradigan qatnovchilar. Maqsad: birinchi oyda to‘rt foizlik CTR, natijani shu maqsad bilan solishtiramiz. Uchala qism ham bugungi darsdan: shior, auditoriya, o‘lchanadigan maqsad. Ko‘rsatkichning raqami va muddati borligini sezdingizmi? „Good engagement“ degan noaniq maqsad o‘rniga „four per cent within a month“ — buni keyin tekshirish mumkin. Uyga vazifada shu tuzilmani kengaytirasiz.
scenes.say: Refill, reuse, repeat. The campaign is aimed at commuters aged twenty to thirty-five who care about waste. Our main goal is a click-through rate of four per cent within the first month, and we will review the result against that target.
scenes.say_uz: To‘ldiring, qayta ishlating, takrorlang. Kampaniya yigirmadan o‘ttiz besh yoshgacha, chiqindi haqida qayg‘uradigan qatnovchilarga qaratilgan. Bizning asosiy maqsadimiz birinchi oyda to‘rt foizlik CTR, natijani shu maqsad bilan solishtiramiz.

scenes.title: Bugungi dars xulosasi
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: xususiyat emas, foyda soting, shior qisqa va ritmik bo‘lsin. Ikkinchi: auditoriyani kim ekani va nimani qadrlashi bo‘yicha tasvirlang, ya’ni demografiya va psixografiya. Uchinchi: brend ovozi doimiy, ohang esa vaziyatga qarab o‘zgaradi. To‘rtinchi: kampaniyani maqsad bilan solishtiring, „exceeded“ yoki „fell short of“ deng va raqam ortidagi xulosani qo‘shing. Shu to‘rtta qadam marketing tilidagi C1 darajadagi ishonchning asosidir.
scenes.say: Let us summarise. Sell benefits, not features. Describe the audience by who they are and what they value. Keep the voice constant and adapt the tone. And judge a campaign against a target, with a short comment on what the numbers suggest.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa qilamiz. Xususiyat emas, foyda soting. Auditoriyani kim ekani va nimani qadrlashi bo‘yicha tasvirlang. Ovozni doimiy saqlang, ohangni moslang. Kampaniyani maqsad bilan solishtirib baholang va raqam nimani anglatishini ayting.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Write a campaign plan: audience, voice, 2 KPIs
Success: benefits, clear target, consistent voice
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa: taxminan ellik so‘zli qisqa reklama va bir sahifalik kampaniya rejasi yozing. Rejada auditoriya, brend ovozi va ikkita o‘lchanadigan maqsad bo‘lsin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: reklamada xususiyat emas, foyda bo‘lsa, maqsadlarda raqam va muddat bo‘lsa va ovoz bir xil saqlangan bo‘lsa. Keyingi darsda turizm va mehmondo‘stlik tilini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to write a short advertisement of about fifty words and a one-page campaign plan with an audience, a brand voice and two measurable goals. Next lesson: tourism and hospitality. Thanks for working with me.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifangiz: taxminan ellik so‘zli qisqa reklama va auditoriya, ovoz va ikkita o‘lchanadigan maqsadli kampaniya rejasi. Keyingi dars: turizm va mehmondo‘stlik. Ishlaganingiz uchun rahmat.

homework_uz: Taxminan ellik so‘zli qisqa reklama va bir sahifalik kampaniya rejasi yozing: auditoriya, brend ovozi va raqam hamda muddatli ikkita o‘lchanadigan maqsad. Reklamada xususiyat emas, foyda bo‘lsin. Keyingi dars: turizm va mehmondo‘stlik.

quiz.q: Which is a benefit, not a feature?
options: Wake up without a sore back.
It has three layers of foam.

quiz.why_uz: Ovoz doimiy, ohang vaziyatga qarab o‘zgaradi.

quiz.q: Conversion rate was 3.8% against a 5% target. It ___ the target.
quiz.why_uz: Natija maqsaddan past: fell short of.

quiz.q: Which verb phrase means the campaign is aimed at someone?

quiz.why_uz: Successful — ikkita c va ikkita s.

quiz.q: Impressions rose 40% but sales stayed flat. The best comment is:
options: This suggests the audience or offer was wrong.
This proves our slogan is perfect.
The campaign was an exact success.
